name: Unextinct
summary: Unextinct is a post-apocalyptic online evolution game with pixel-art graphics. In 2082 a rogue AI destroyed humanity. Long after, an emergency cloning pod at the bottom of a drowned world wakes the player as a single microbe. From there the player evolves into a virus, a bacterium, a predator, a herbivore or another organism across more than 180 branching evolution stages, and 33 skills improve through use. The world has over 90 locations with environmental hazards such as radiation, heat, cold, toxins and lack of oxygen, along with riddle quests, puzzles and lore stories. Players fight each other in real-time PvP, form colonies, capture territory in scheduled battles and compete in the Cube, a last-survivor tournament.
